نتحاضن (form VI)
# نَتَحَاضَنُ (nataḥāḍanu) /na.ta.ħaː.dˤa.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# نَتَحَاضَنَ (nataḥāḍana) /na.ta.ħaː.dˤa.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# نَتَحَاضَنْ (nataḥāḍan) /na.ta.ħaː.dˤan/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
